name: codepulse-api
description: Pay-per-call disposable email boxes, SMS verification scraping, certificate transparency logs, whois details, sitemap parsing, HaveIBeenPwned checks, PDF parsing, OCR scanners, QR builders, sitemap readers, package registries, and DNS diagnostics for AI agents, paid for with USDC on Base or Solana.

tools.name: webSearch
tools.description: Performs web searches using a free DuckDuckGo HTML parser. Returns organic search results.

tools.name: webScrape
tools.description: Extracts clean readable text from any website URL.

tools.name: webMarkdown
tools.description: Downloads HTML and compiles it to markdown locally using Turndown.

tools.name: webMetadata
tools.description: Extracts OpenGraph tags, description, keywords, and page header meta tags.

tools.name: webHistory
tools.description: Queries historical website snapshots from the free Archive.org API.

tools.name: webRss
tools.description: Parses any public RSS or Atom XML feed URL into structured JSON.

tools.name: webSitemap
tools.description: Resolves and lists all URLs inside a sitemap XML.

tools.name: webDnsTxt
tools.description: Fetches TXT, MX, A, CNAME, and CAA records for a domain via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS.

tools.name: webWhois
tools.description: Queries global registry metadata via the public RDAP protocol to find registration details.

tools.name: mailboxCreate
tools.description: Generates a temporary disposable inbox address using the free 1secmail.com service.

tools.name: mailboxMessages
tools.description: Polls the disposable inbox for messages and verification codes.

tools.name: phoneTempSms
tools.description: Lists active public numbers available for temporary SMS verification codes.

tools.name: phoneMessages
tools.description: Queries public SMS verification boards to retrieve recent OTP codes.

tools.name: webhookListen
tools.description: Generates a unique callback URL. Any POST request sent to this URL will be recorded.

tools.name: webhookPoll
tools.description: Retrieves all callback request payloads received by the listener.

tools.name: notifyTelegram
tools.description: Dispatches telegram messages using a bot token and chat identifier.

tools.name: notifySlack
tools.description: Posts messages directly to developer channels via Slack webhooks.

tools.name: notifyDiscord
tools.description: Relays markdown notification cards to Discord webhooks.

tools.name: notifyEmail
tools.description: Sends automated email notifications using the Resend API.

tools.name: domainCheck
tools.description: Checks domain registration availability by checking SOA DNS records.

tools.name: domainSocial
tools.description: Checks availability of a handle across major social platforms (GitHub, Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram).

tools.name: brandPalette
tools.description: Parses CSS hex and rgb colors on a target website to resolve brand colors.

tools.name: brandLogo
tools.description: Extracts high-resolution logo links using Clearbit's free logo API.

tools.name: networkSslExpiry
tools.description: Checks domain certificate logs on CertSpotter for SSL expiry dates and issuers.

tools.name: networkDnssec
tools.description: Verifies the presence of DNSSEC keys and signatures on a domain via DoH.

tools.name: ipPatent
tools.description: Searches official USPTO patent database records using title query keywords or a specific patent number.

tools.name: ipTrademark
tools.description: Audits word conflicts in public trademark indexes to verify name availability.

tools.name: companySec
tools.description: Queries recent SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) by ticker or CIK identifier.

tools.name: companyAddress
tools.description: Resolves official corporate address and incorporation details from SEC EDGAR registry records.

tools.name: registryNpm
tools.description: Retrieves version history, dependencies, and author details from the official NPM registry.

tools.name: registryPypi
tools.description: Fetches package descriptions, requirements, and release version numbers from PyPI.

tools.name: registryCrates
tools.description: Looks up Rust crate details, downloads history, and dependencies from Crates.io.

tools.name: registryGolang
tools.description: Queries Go release tags and modules list from proxy.golang.org.

tools.name: registryPackagist
tools.description: Resolves PHP library requirements and tags from Packagist.org.

tools.name: registryMaven
tools.description: Queries Java package group and artifact structures from Maven Central.

tools.name: registryCdnjs
tools.description: Resolves Javascript/CSS file paths hosted on cdnjs.

tools.name: registryGithubRepo
tools.description: Reads star counts, issues, forks, and description for a GitHub repository.

tools.name: registryGithubRelease
tools.description: Retrieves the latest tag release and release notes for a GitHub repository.

tools.name: registryGithubLicense
tools.description: Scrapes and parses repository license configurations from GitHub.

tools.name: securitySecretScan
tools.description: Runs high-accuracy regular expression scans on a text block to find leaked API keys, tokens, or private keys.

tools.name: securityCve
tools.description: Checks package names and versions against the free open-source vulnerability database OSV.dev.

tools.name: securityIpAbuse
tools.description: Queries IP reputation scoring to detect botnet, spamming, or hacking origin IPs.

tools.name: securityHashCheck
tools.description: Verifies file MD5/SHA256 threat signatures against open vulnerability directories.

tools.name: securityPwnedPassword
tools.description: Securly audits passwords against HaveIBeenPwned database leaks using k-Anonymity hashing locally.

tools.name: securityHttpHeaders
tools.description: Queries target URL headers to score security configurations (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options).

tools.name: mediaPdfText
tools.description: Extracts and parses text strings from a public PDF document URL.

tools.name: mediaOcr
tools.description: Performs optical character recognition (OCR) on an image URL to read its text.

tools.name: mediaChart
tools.description: Generates charts (bar, line, pie) from JSON configuration payloads using QuickChart.io.

tools.name: mediaQrGenerate
tools.description: Generates a QR code image buffer from a text string.

tools.name: mediaBarcodeRead
tools.description: Decodes EAN, UPC, or ISBN barcode values from an image URL.
